compiled_state.title: Observe CI multi-cycle dispatch and capture BLOCK/DEFER/DROP arbiter ruling evidence
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: CI runs through max_cycles=4 cycles OR until STABLE_HALT fires. PR comments show `DSO-Review-Cycle: K commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json>` markers per cycle.
- dd-3: Arbiter PR comment posted with marker `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>`, summary table, BLOCK list highlighted.
- dd-4: BLOCK demonstration — finding receives BLOCK ruling; PR check status reflects it.
- dd-5: DEFER demonstration — finding receives DEFER ruling; orphan ticket created with required tags; visible via `dso ticket list --tag=orphan:deferred_review`.
- dd-6: DROP demonstration — finding receives DROP ruling; defense record written to both stores; visible via tracker comments showing DEFENSE_RECORD; PR comment visible.

Wait for the CI llm-review pipeline triggered by task-1's PR to complete its multi-cycle run (use `plugins/dso/scripts/wait-for-pr.sh`). Inspect the PR artifacts, the local tracker, and the GitHub PR comments to confirm:
  - The cycle dispatcher posted `DSO-Review-Cycle: K commit_sha=<sha> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json>` markers for cycles 1..K where K is either max_cycles=4 or the cycle at which STABLE_HALT fires.
  - The cycle-end arbiter posted exactly one `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>` comment containing a summary table and a highlighted BLOCK section.
  - At least one finding received BLOCK; at least one received DEFER (with an orphan ticket created carrying tags `orphan:deferred_review` AND `origin:arbiter`); at least one received DROP (with a defense record written to the tracker store AND visible on the GitHub PR comments).
  - The PR check status reflects the BLOCK ruling (failure or pending state).

These checks are grouped into a single task because per the decomposition instructions, splitting them into per-ruling sub-tasks would force three separate waits on the same CI artifact set without producing independently observable behaviors — Gate 3 only requires splitting where each split independently meets Gate 1 AND Gate 2.

Record the orphan ticket ID(s), the DROP defense URL, the DROP defense count (baseline for task-3), the arbiter PR comment URL, and a BLOCK evidence pointer (failed-check commit SHA or screenshot path) as task progress notes (key:value lines: `orphan_ticket: <id>`, `drop_defense_url: <url>`, `drop_defense_count: <N>`, `arbiter_comment_url: <url>`, `block_evidence: <sha-or-path>`) — task-4 (epic description update) and task-3 (idempotency baseline) consume these.

Note on test exemption: test-exempt — observational task against shipped runtime (cycle dispatcher, arbiter, orphan-creation hook, defense store wiring); the runtime is already covered by the fixture-replay harness named in task-1.

**Escalation note (from review)**: If CI does not produce ALL three ruling types (BLOCK, DEFER, DROP) after max_cycles=4, escalate to user with the CI run URL and a description of which rulings were observed. Do NOT close dd-5 or dd-6 until both DEFER and DROP are confirmed. If necessary, adjust scratch/sc10-scenario.py content (new commit) to strengthen the DEFER/DROP-eliciting patterns and re-run.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Universal (always run):**
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Tests pass
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh

**Task-specific (resolves PR # via `PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+')` before each Verify):**
- [ ] dd-2: Cycle markers present (1..max_cycles=4 or until STABLE_HALT)
  Verify: PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/issues/$PR_NUM/comments --jq '[.[] | select(.body | test("DSO-Review-Cycle:"))] | length' | awk '$1>=1 && $1<=4 {exit 0} {exit 1}'
- [ ] dd-3: Exactly one DSO-Arbiter-Ruling comment present
  Verify: PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/issues/$PR_NUM/comments --jq '[.[] | select(.body | test("DSO-Arbiter-Ruling:"))] | length' | grep -q '^1$'
- [ ] dd-4: PR check status reflects BLOCK (failure or pending/action_required)
  Verify: PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); gh pr view $PR_NUM --json statusCheckRollup --jq '.statusCheckRollup[] | select(.name | test("llm-review")) | .conclusion' | grep -qiE 'failure|action_required|pending'
- [ ] dd-5: Orphan ticket recorded as progress note `orphan_ticket: <id>` AND carries BOTH `orphan:deferred_review` AND `origin:arbiter` tags
  Verify: ORPHAN=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 | grep -oE 'orphan_ticket: [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}'); [ -n "$ORPHAN" ] && TAGS=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show "$ORPHAN" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(",".join(d.get("tags",[])))'); echo "$TAGS" | grep -q 'orphan:deferred_review' && echo "$TAGS" | grep -q 'origin:arbiter'
- [ ] dd-6: DROP defense record present in tracker AND on PR
  Verify: PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/issues/$PR_NUM/comments --jq '[.[] | select(.body | test("DEFENSE_RECORD.*dropped_by_arbiter"))] | length' | awk '$1>=1 {exit 0} {exit 1}'
- [ ] Progress notes for downstream tasks (drop_defense_count, arbiter_comment_url, block_evidence) recorded
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'drop_defense_count: [0-9]+' && .claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'arbiter_comment_url: https?://'
- [ ] Progress note `orphan_count_baseline: <N>` recorded (total orphan tickets with tag orphan:deferred_review AND origin:arbiter at observation time — closes task-3 idempotency fallback hole)
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'orphan_count_baseline: [0-9]+'
- [ ] Progress note `cycle_marker_count_baseline: <N>` recorded (count of DSO-Review-Cycle PR comments at observation time)
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'cycle_marker_count_baseline: [0-9]+'

comments.body:
CHECKPOINT 4/6: Observations captured ✓

KEY FINDING: llm-review was SKIPPED via provenance check. The sc10 commit (be6ffb2f) is associated with PR #252 itself, so verify-session-provenance.sh marks it provenanced (exit 0), and llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh outputs 'CONCLUSION: skipped / Covered by sub-PR reviews: PR#?:be6ffb2f'. No review cycle dispatcher ran, no arbiter was invoked, no BLOCK/DEFER/DROP rulings were produced.

dd-2 cycle_marker_count: 0 (FAIL — expected 1..4)
dd-3 arbiter_comment: 0 (FAIL — expected exactly 1)
dd-4 llm-review conclusion: SUCCESS (check passed, but because review was SKIPPED not because BLOCK was resolved)
dd-5 orphan_ticket: none (FAIL — DEFER ruling never fired)
dd-6 drop_defense_count: 0 (FAIL — DROP ruling never fired)

Root cause: The sc10-scenario.py file is committed directly onto the session PR #252 branch. When verify-session-provenance.sh checks the commit, it calls the GitHub API /repos/.../commits/{sha}/pulls which returns PR #252 itself — so the commit is considered 'provenanced by sub-PR' and the full-diff LLM review is skipped entirely. The multi-cycle arbiter dispatch in ci-llm-review-runner.sh is never reached.

CHECKPOINT 4/6: Observations captured (cycle=0 arbiter=0 drop=0 orphan_baseline=0) ✓

KEY FINDING (retry #2): llm-review STILL SKIPPED via provenance check despite adding tests/sc10_evidence_TEMP_DELETE.py on commit 571c32b9f1.

Root cause (confirmed): verify-session-provenance.sh calls GitHub API repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/commits/571c32b9f1.../pulls → returns PR #253 itself → commit considered 'provenanced by sub-PR'. INTEGRATION_SCOPE_COUNT=0 (empty). llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh outputs 'All commits provenanced' / 'CONCLUSION: skipped'.

The provenance check strategy does not distinguish between:
  (A) commits on sub-story-PRs that were reviewed before being merged into the session PR  
  (B) commits added directly to the session PR branch (which are associated with the session PR, not a sub-PR)

Both paths produce 'PR exists for commit' → 'provenanced' → SKIP. No review dispatcher, no arbiter, no BLOCK/DEFER/DROP rulings.
